series_short_description: Pulled barefoot from their tiny studio bed into Vaeloria, Nolan (24) and Gwen (19) journey toward home.
series_description: At twenty-one, verbal autistic retail associate Nolan Lennox (5'7") missed every hidden signal when polite, five-foot-tall Tammy puffed out her chest over a Day-1 lunch at the Emerald Creek Mall food court and told him she was ready for everything—soon finding himself rushed into her un-air-conditioned trailer off Route 13. Two years and two breakups later, when Tammy impulsively drags twenty-three-year-old Nolan to the Norfolk Pathfinder terminal for a surprise ninety-nine-dollar Seattle trip without calling forty-eight hours ahead for a wheelchair lift, an interactive Story Crossroads places Nolan's fate in your hands: lock both wheelchair brakes in public and ride CVTA home to Emerald Creek, or freeze and endure the cross-country Pathfinder route until sister Gwen (6'1") and Shift Supervisor Mallory Walsh race west to bring him home. Across every Earth route, Nolan and Gwen rebuild together inside tiny rectangular Studio 205 at Norfolk's Harborview Towers with Mallory at Nolan's side—until an amber rift pulls brother and sister barefoot on Lofstrand forearm crutches into twin-moon Vaeloria.
author: Michael Ragsdale
